evidence_backed_claims: BM25 is very strong because telecom figure captions contain exact acronyms, protocol names, and procedural keywords.
Dense retrieval helps when wording changes or query text is semantic/paraphrased.
M7 hybrid is useful because lexical and dense signals complement each other, but gains over the strongest BM25 baseline are practically small/modest depending on query set.
Zero-shot visual models show a domain gap on telecom technical diagrams.
OCR is useful diagnostically but noisy as a primary retrieval signal.
M9A E1 shows higher held-out visual retrieval metrics than zero-shot CLIP on a duplicate-safe test split.
remaining_limitations: Reliance on clean text metadata for the primary text-first architecture.
OCR noise degrading pure visual text matching.
